display_long_description:
Discover the fascinating world of equine anatomy in breathtaking 3D

Key Features:

Place lifelike 3D models of horse anatomy in your real-world environment

Adjust the size of the models to suit your needs and explore every detail

Interactive labels: Tap on specific parts of the horse to access detailed information

About Us:
ATM is a renowned educational institute specializing in animal physiotherapy, osteopathy, chiropractic, and naturopathy. Our focus is on providing comprehensive theoretical and practical knowledge. We offer a wide range of seminars and meetings, where experienced instructors from both practice and academia deliver hands-on, theory-based education to support effective training.

Our unique teaching approach combines various media formats including interactive multimedia scripts, videos, learning apps, podcasts, and practical guides for creating anatomical specimens—ensuring continuous, high-quality support for our learners.

In addition to our core offerings, we provide numerous optional and free additional services for all students. These include a wide range of continuing education opportunities and specializations, allowing our students to deepen their knowledge and expand their skill sets.

Please, see further information:
https://www.atm.de
